builder_identity.name: build_js_ast.py
builder_identity.scope: JavaScript structure — MVP vertical slice: File + Function nodes + the `calls` edge (spec/js-support.md US-1).

builder_principles.structure_only: Emit facts observed in the syntax tree. No framework interpretation (that is an adapter's job).
builder_principles.no_best_guessing: A `calls` edge is emitted ONLY when the callee resolves to exactly one known function definition. A dynamic/unknown callee becomes an unresolved ambiguity, never a guessed edge.
builder_principles.determinism: Same input -> same fragment. Literal-resolvable target -> deterministic edge; otherwise emit_ambiguity(confidence='unresolved') for Level-2 (LLM) resolution.
